title: Choose the new Characterly world
question: Fresh hand. The roll assigned The Character Archive. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Character Archive
options.lineage: Gacha-game character archive and profile screens (collection, bond level, unlocked story entries)
options.thesis: Each companion has an archive page that fills in as they get to know you: bond rises, memories unlock, and you can see where every entry came from.
materials: full-height character art on a pale field
crisp archive panels with tab rows
rarity-colour accents used as data, not decoration
options.viewport: A large companion portrait with an archive panel beside it: Bond, Profile, What they remember (each entry tagged DM or server), and a large 'Continue with Discord' confirm button.
options.risk: Can read as an anime-game costume or hint at gacha mechanics; it needs real character art, and there must be no pulls, odds or rarity-for-sale.

raised.raise: Charged emptiness: one character, real negative space, no HUD clutter around the portrait.
State is a mark, not a colour: pinned, edited and forgotten each get a distinct mark, legible in greyscale.
No boxes for grouping; rank comes from scale and depth, so panels stay few and flat.
Actions have visible consequence: forgetting removes the entry with a mark you can see, never a silent vanish.

options.label: The Character Card
options.lineage: Trading-card-game cards: frame, art box, type line, ability text, foil
options.thesis: The character card migrants already trade becomes the page: its ability text is what this companion remembers about you.
options.viewport: One oversized character card held at a slight angle; its rules text reads 'Remembers you. Follows you into your servers.' with Continue with Discord and Bring your card beside it.
options.risk: Familiar collectible framing; a card per section would turn into a template grid.

options.label: Provenance Ribbon
options.thesis: One continuous ribbon traces where each memory came from: said in DMs, heard in a server, edited, forgotten.
options.viewport: A red ribbon runs down the page through dated folds of a companion's memory, ending at 'Continue with Discord'.
options.case: Fuses cleanly with inspectable memory and the DM/server boundary; loses on audience, since migrants don't think in museum archives.
options.risk: Can go solemn and archival, close to the rejected editorial look.

options.label: Streaming Title Wall
options.thesis: The shelf as rows of character posters; the one you focus expands to say who they are and what they'd remember.
options.viewport: Rows of character posters under a hero row; the focused poster expands with Continue with Discord.
options.case: Migrants know this grammar from Character.AI's home; weak on showing memory.
options.risk: Dark ground nears the rejected look and the category default.

options.label: Ikebana Ma
options.thesis: One asymmetric arrangement with charged emptiness.
options.viewport: One branch rising through empty plaster.
options.case: Fuses poorly: contemplative restraint fights a lively fandom audience.

options.label: Cutting Bench Rail
options.thesis: State marked by grease crosses and tape flags on a film rail.
options.viewport: An orange perforated rail across a black sheet.
options.case: Fuses poorly: an editor's tool, alien to migrants.
options.kept: State is a mark, not a hue.

options.label: Cracktro Scroller
options.thesis: Rank by depth over a drifting void, never enclosed.
options.viewport: One ivory line over drifting dust.
options.case: Fuses poorly: black void plus glowing accent is the rejected look.
options.kept: No enclosure; rank by depth and scale.

options.label: Leather Skeuomorph
options.thesis: Digital things as stitched, torn, loved objects.
options.viewport: A leather-headed shelf of curling pages.
options.case: Fuses poorly: ornament as costume, which the owner rejected.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A character-chat marketplace page, played straight at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Search-led hero over a grid of character cards with a sign-in button.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Character.AI and its clones by design.
